$comment: Controlled vocabulary of marker keys that substance monitors[].marker_key may reference. Every entry is shaped as a human-system bulk-import `marker` object (docs/schema/bulk-import.schema.json $defs/marker) so the app can adopt this file directly as its builtin marker seed. Keys match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]*$ and never change.
notes: NO reference intervals are published here. An interval is a property of the assay and the reference population, not of the compound catalog. The app owns ref_low / ref_high / ref_kind / ref_source; this file deliberately omits them rather than assert unverified numbers.

NO LOINC codes are published here. SPEC 1.3 requires a LOINC code to travel with one of four approved LOINC display names verbatim. LOINC is not on this repo's licence allowlist and was not retrieved, so binding is left to the app. Do not infer codes from these keys.
system values are the thirteen human-system body-system keys a fresh install seeds.

who5 is also an `instrument` in the app's bulk-import schema. It appears here because the original catalog brief lists it as a marker key; the app should decide which surface owns it and drop the other.

markers.name: Hemoglobin A1c
markers.description: Glycated haemoglobin; integrates glycaemia over roughly the preceding three months.

markers.name: Fasting glucose
markers.description: Plasma glucose after an overnight fast.

markers.name: Fasting insulin
markers.description: Serum insulin after an overnight fast.

markers.name: C-peptide
markers.description: Cleavage product of proinsulin; indexes endogenous insulin secretion independently of injected insulin.

markers.name: Amylase
markers.description: Pancreatic and salivary enzyme; elevated in pancreatic inflammation.

markers.name: Lipase
markers.description: Pancreas-specific lipolytic enzyme; the more specific of the two pancreatic enzymes.

markers.name: Beta-hydroxybutyrate
markers.description: Dominant circulating ketone body; rises in ketoacidosis including the euglycaemic form.

markers.name: IGF-1
markers.description: Insulin-like growth factor 1; the stable downstream index of growth-hormone exposure.

markers.name: IGFBP-3
markers.description: Principal IGF-1 binding protein; read alongside IGF-1 to interpret free IGF-1.

markers.name: Prolactin
markers.description: Anterior pituitary hormone under dopaminergic inhibitory control.

markers.name: Cortisol, morning
markers.description: Morning serum cortisol, drawn near the diurnal peak.

markers.name: ACTH
markers.description: Adrenocorticotropic hormone; read with cortisol to localise an axis abnormality.

markers.name: TSH
markers.description: Thyroid-stimulating hormone; the pituitary's read on thyroid sufficiency.

markers.name: Free T4
markers.description: Unbound thyroxine, the circulating prohormone.

markers.name: Free T3
markers.description: Unbound triiodothyronine, the active thyroid hormone at the receptor.

markers.name: Thyroid peroxidase antibody
markers.description: Autoantibody against thyroid peroxidase; marks autoimmune thyroid disease.

markers.name: Testosterone, total
markers.description: Total serum testosterone, bound plus free.

markers.name: Testosterone, free
markers.description: Unbound testosterone; the fraction not held by SHBG or albumin.

markers.name: Sex hormone binding globulin
markers.description: Principal carrier protein for testosterone and estradiol; sets the bound/free split.

markers.name: Estradiol
markers.description: Primary circulating estrogen; in males chiefly aromatised from testosterone.

markers.name: LH
markers.description: Luteinising hormone; drives testicular Leydig-cell steroidogenesis.

markers.name: FSH
markers.description: Follicle-stimulating hormone; drives Sertoli-cell support of spermatogenesis.

markers.name: DHEA-sulfate
markers.description: Sulfated adrenal androgen precursor; the stable circulating form of DHEA.

markers.name: Sperm concentration
markers.description: Spermatozoa per millilitre of ejaculate on semen analysis.

markers.name: PSA, total
markers.description: Total prostate-specific antigen.

markers.name: PSA, free percent
markers.description: Free PSA as a percentage of total; refines interpretation of an intermediate total.

markers.name: Hemoglobin
markers.description: Oxygen-carrying protein concentration in whole blood.

markers.name: Hematocrit
markers.description: Packed red-cell volume as a fraction of whole blood.

markers.name: Red blood cell count
markers.description: Erythrocyte count per microlitre.

markers.name: Mean corpuscular volume
markers.description: Average erythrocyte volume; separates macrocytic from microcytic anaemia.

markers.name: White blood cell count
markers.description: Total leukocyte count per microlitre.

markers.name: Absolute neutrophil count
markers.description: Neutrophil count per microlitre; the operative number in myelosuppression.

markers.name: Platelet count
markers.description: Thrombocyte count per microlitre.

markers.name: Ferritin
markers.description: Iron storage protein; also an acute-phase reactant.

markers.name: Iron, serum
markers.description: Circulating transferrin-bound iron.

markers.name: Total iron binding capacity
markers.description: Total transferrin iron-binding capacity.

markers.name: Transferrin saturation
markers.description: Serum iron divided by TIBC; the usable index of iron availability.

markers.name: Vitamin B12
markers.description: Serum cobalamin.

markers.name: Folate
markers.description: Serum folate.

markers.name: Homocysteine
markers.description: Sulfur amino acid rising with B12, folate or B6 insufficiency.

markers.name: ALT
markers.description: Alanine aminotransferase; the more hepatocyte-specific transaminase.

markers.name: AST
markers.description: Aspartate aminotransferase; hepatic and also muscle-derived.

markers.name: Alkaline phosphatase
markers.description: Enzyme of biliary and bone origin; the cholestatic transaminase.

markers.name: GGT
markers.description: Gamma-glutamyl transferase; separates hepatobiliary from bone ALP elevation.

markers.name: Bilirubin, total
markers.description: Total serum bilirubin, conjugated plus unconjugated.

markers.name: Albumin
markers.description: Principal serum protein; indexes hepatic synthetic function.

markers.name: Creatinine
markers.description: Muscle-derived filtration marker; confounded by muscle mass and creatine intake.

markers.name: eGFR, creatinine-based
markers.description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate from creatinine.

markers.name: Cystatin C
markers.description: Filtration marker independent of muscle mass.

markers.name: eGFR, cystatin C-based
markers.description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate from cystatin C; the estimate to prefer when muscle mass is atypical.

markers.name: Blood urea nitrogen
markers.description: Urea nitrogen; moves with filtration, protein intake and volume status.

markers.name: Urine albumin-creatinine ratio
markers.description: Spot urine albumin normalised to creatinine; indexes glomerular leak.

markers.name: Potassium
markers.description: Serum potassium.

markers.name: Sodium
markers.description: Serum sodium.

markers.name: Calcium, serum
markers.description: Total serum calcium.

markers.name: Magnesium, serum
markers.description: Serum magnesium; a narrow window over a largely intracellular store.

markers.name: Magnesium, red blood cell
markers.description: Intraerythrocyte magnesium; tracks body stores more closely than serum.

markers.name: Uric acid
markers.description: Terminal purine metabolite cleared renally.

markers.name: Cholesterol, total
markers.description: Total serum cholesterol across all lipoprotein classes.

markers.name: LDL cholesterol
markers.description: Cholesterol carried on low-density lipoprotein.

markers.name: HDL cholesterol
markers.description: Cholesterol carried on high-density lipoprotein.

markers.name: Non-HDL cholesterol
markers.description: Total cholesterol minus HDL; sums all atherogenic particles.

markers.name: Triglycerides
markers.description: Serum triglycerides, fasting-sensitive.

markers.name: Apolipoprotein B
markers.description: One ApoB per atherogenic particle; a particle count rather than a cholesterol mass.

markers.name: Lipoprotein(a)
markers.description: Largely genetically set atherogenic lipoprotein; measured once unless a targeted agent is used.

markers.name: LDL particle number
markers.description: LDL particle concentration by NMR.

markers.name: C-reactive protein, high sensitivity
markers.description: High-sensitivity CRP; a general inflammatory index used in cardiovascular risk.

markers.name: Creatine kinase
markers.description: Muscle enzyme; rises with myopathy and with exercise or creatine loading.

markers.name: Omega-3 index
markers.description: EPA plus DHA as a percentage of erythrocyte membrane fatty acids.

markers.name: Vitamin D, 25-hydroxy
markers.description: 25-hydroxyvitamin D; the storage form and the standard status marker.

markers.name: Zinc, plasma
markers.description: Plasma zinc.

markers.name: Copper, serum
markers.description: Serum copper; falls with sustained high-dose zinc intake.

markers.name: Lean mass
markers.description: Total lean soft-tissue mass by body-composition scan.

markers.name: Fat mass
markers.description: Total fat mass by body-composition scan.

markers.name: Body fat percentage
markers.description: Fat mass as a percentage of total mass. Note: the app also carries body_fat_pct as a daily metric_key; a monitor binds to this marker, not to that stream.

markers.name: Bone mineral density T-score
markers.description: Bone mineral density expressed in standard deviations from a young-adult reference.

markers.name: WHO-5 Well-Being Index
markers.description: Five-item well-being index, scored 0-100. Also present as an `instrument` in the app's bulk-import schema.
